weather_summary: Sunnyvale should be mild for August, roughly low-to-mid 70s this weekend; San Jose runs warmer, roughly mid-80s to mid-90s Saturday and cooler Sunday. Favor morning outdoor events, shade, water, and indoor museum/library backups for hotter San Jose and Fremont plans.

events.title: Something Fun For Everyone Family Festival
events.label: Best local festival
events.place: Sunnyvale Baylands Park, Sunnyvale
events.cost: Free admission; optional activities and food for purchase
events.food: Festival food, lunch options, popcorn, snow cones, and nearby North Sunnyvale restaurants
events.why: Closest high-signal pick: inclusive family festival with games, music, arts and crafts, scavenger hunt, barnyard buddies, resource fair, and food in a flexible daytime window.
events.sourceName: Autism Society San Francisco Bay Area

events.title: KidStock Mountain View
events.label: Best toddler music
events.place: Civic Center Plaza and Pioneer Park, Mountain View
events.food: Castro Street cafes, bakeries, and lunch nearby
events.why: A kid-focused city festival with live children's music, DJ dance party, games, crafts, STEM and sports activities, and easy downtown food nearby.
events.sourceName: City of Mountain View / Colorful Bunch confirmation

events.title: Sunnyvale Farmers Market + Miss Meggie Tunes + Taiko
events.label: Closest food walk
events.time: Sat, Aug 15, market 9:00 AM-1:00 PM; library music 11:00 AM; taiko noon
events.place: Downtown Sunnyvale and Sunnyvale Public Library
events.food: Market fruit, baked goods, coffee, casual downtown restaurants, and snack stops
events.why: The lowest-friction plan: start with market snacks, then use the library music program if the toddler wants structure or shade.

events.title: Sweet Pea and Lil' Ninjas Open House
events.label: Indoor wiggles
events.time: Sat, Aug 15; check listing for exact open-house hours
events.place: Monta Vista Recreation Center, Cupertino
events.cost: Listed as an open house; verify registration or fee before leaving
events.food: Cupertino cafes, Main Street, and casual lunch nearby
events.why: Strong heat-proof toddler option with climbing, swinging, balancing, and play for ages 1-12.

events.title: Qixi Festival Storytime
events.label: Sunday library
events.place: Sunnyvale Public Library, Sunnyvale
events.food: Downtown Sunnyvale snacks, coffee, and early dinner nearby
events.why: A short indoor cultural storytime for children ages 3 and up, useful as a Sunday nap-adjacent low-cost plan.

events.title: Environmental Education Center Open House
events.label: Nature hands-on
events.time: Sat, Aug 15; check listing for exact drop-in hours
events.place: McClellan Ranch Preserve, Cupertino
events.food: Pack snacks; Cupertino food options nearby after
events.why: Animal ambassadors and hands-on preserve activities make this a strong nature option if you go early and keep expectations flexible.

events.title: Children's Discovery Museum Toddler Storytime + Dino Shadows
events.label: Museum backup
events.time: Sat or Sun during museum hours; toddler storytime runs Wed-Sun
events.place: Children's Discovery Museum of San Jose
events.food: Downtown San Jose lunch and snack options nearby
events.why: Purpose-built toddler environment with indoor exhibits, a weekend storytime pattern, and easy exit control if the day gets hot or overstimulating.
events.sourceName: Children's Discovery Museum of San Jose

events.title: Palo Alto Junior Museum & Zoo
events.label: Animals + play
events.time: Sat or Sun morning; reserve admission
events.place: Palo Alto Junior Museum & Zoo, Palo Alto
events.cost: Paid admission; children under 12 months free
events.food: Town & Country, California Ave, or picnic at Rinconada Park
events.why: Very strong toddler-scale venue with animals and hands-on exhibits; best as a morning timed-entry plan.

events.title: Mountain View Farmers Market
events.label: Sunday market
events.place: Downtown Mountain View Caltrain Station parking lot
events.food: 70+ growers and food vendors plus Castro Street restaurants
events.why: Reliable Sunday food walk with excellent stroller logistics, transit access, and enough snacks to make it feel like an outing without a fixed schedule.

events.title: Campbell Farmers Market
events.label: Downtown market
events.place: Downtown Campbell
events.food: Farmers market snacks, bakeries, coffee, and downtown lunch
events.why: One of the better market-plus-food strolls in the South Bay, with a clear morning window and easy brunch pairing.

events.title: Santa Clara Farmers Market
events.label: Saturday market
events.place: Jackson Street and Homestead Road, Santa Clara
events.food: Produce, prepared foods, juice, coffee, and Santa Clara lunch nearby
events.why: Close, simple, and flexible Saturday food outing with toddler-friendly browsing and a clean exit before nap.

events.title: California Avenue Farmers Market
events.label: Palo Alto snacks
events.place: California Avenue, Palo Alto
events.food: Market produce, baked goods, coffee, and California Ave restaurants
events.why: Good northbound market option with food density and a strollerable street, best if you already want Palo Alto.

events.title: Swades - Celebrate India & Parade
events.label: Big cultural festival
events.place: Cesar Chavez Park / Plaza Park, Downtown San Jose
events.cost: Free entry registration listed; food for purchase
events.food: Indian food festival vendors and downtown San Jose restaurants
events.why: Strong cultural and food event, but the late/crowded window makes it better as a short early-evening taste than a full toddler plan.

events.title: Festival of India Mela and Parade
events.label: Fremont festival
events.place: 39439 Paseo Padre Parkway, Fremont
events.cost: Free fair/mela access; food and purchases optional
events.food: Indian festival food, sweets, drinks, and vendor booths
events.why: Large cultural fair with food and parade energy; worth considering if you want a bigger outing and can manage crowds.

events.title: Foster City Summer Days
events.label: Worth-drive festival
events.time: Sat-Sun, Aug 15-16; core family activities late morning through afternoon
events.place: Leo J. Ryan Park, Foster City
events.cost: Free admission; rides, workshops, kitten lounge, food, and parking may cost extra
events.food: Moveable Feast food booths, specialty drinks, ice cream, and festival snacks
events.why: Bigger drive, but unusually strong for families: carnival, food booths, maker market, live entertainment, kitten lounge, and rubber ducky scavenger hunt.
events.sourceName: San Jose Made / Foster City Summer Days

events.title: Pacific Bus Museum Annual Summer Open House
events.label: Vehicle kid
events.place: Pacific Bus Museum, Fremont
events.cost: Free event; BBQ lunch donation optional
events.food: BBQ lunch donation listed; Fremont food nearby
events.why: Good for vehicle-obsessed toddlers: restored buses, walk-through viewing, memorabilia, lunch, and a compact visit length.

events.title: Bay Area Games Day
events.label: Indoor games
events.place: Los Altos Library, Los Altos
events.food: Downtown Los Altos cafes and lunch nearby
events.why: A free indoor option for families who like board games; toddler fit depends on attention span, so treat it as a short drop-in.
events.sourceName: Colorful Bunch / Santa Clara County Library official details

events.title: San Jose Public Library Math Festival and Backpack Giveaway
events.label: Older-sibling useful
events.time: Sat, Aug 15, midday/early afternoon; check branch listing
events.place: Seven Trees and Educational Park branches, San Jose
events.food: Branch-dependent; plan snacks before leaving
events.why: Not the strongest toddler-only pick, but useful if there is an older sibling or you want a free indoor back-to-school errand/activity combo.

events.title: Happy Hollow Park & Zoo morning visit
events.label: Animal fallback
events.place: Happy Hollow Park & Zoo, San Jose
events.food: Onsite snacks plus nearby Kelley Park / San Jose food
events.why: Reliable toddler attraction with animals and play areas, but San Jose heat makes it an early-only plan this weekend.

events.title: Gaiascope at Circle of Palms
events.label: Short art stop
events.time: Sat or Sun morning; installation listed through Aug 18
events.place: Circle of Palms, Downtown San Jose
events.food: San Pedro Square Market, downtown cafes, and museum-adjacent food
events.why: A short visual stop with stroller access; pair it with lunch or a museum rather than treating it as the whole outing.

events.title: Starlight Saturdays - Bring It On
events.label: Evening movie
events.place: St. James Park, San Jose
events.cost: Free or low cost; verify event page
events.food: Downtown San Jose food before the movie
events.why: Useful only if bedtime is flexible; it is family-accessible but not toddler-optimized because of late timing and sound.
